## File: facebookresearch_pytouch/pytouch/tasks/surface3d/geometry.py

Prompts

```
['preprocess a normal map tensor by centering, normalizing, and setting background normals to face the camera', 'convert a surface normal map into depth gradient tensors along x and y axes in meters', 'integrate depth gradient tensors into a reconstructed depth map using Poisson reconstruction', 'back-project a 2D depth map into 3D world coordinates using projection and view matrices', 'remove statistical outliers from a 3D point cloud using Open3D with configurable neighbor count and std ratio']
```

Usage

```
{'preproc_normal': 'preprocess a normal map tensor by centering, normalizing, and setting background normals to face the camera', 'normal_to_grad_depth': 'convert a surface normal map into depth gradient tensors along x and y axes in meters', 'integrate_grad_depth': 'integrate depth gradient tensors into a reconstructed depth map using Poisson reconstruction', 'depth_to_pts3d': 'back-project a 2D depth map into 3D world coordinates using projection and view matrices', 'remove_outlier_pts': 'remove statistical outliers from a 3D point cloud using Open3D with configurable neighbor count and std ratio'}
```
